title: BiForge common Phase-1 definitions
description: Shared status vocabulary and evidence provenance used by all AI-NATIVE-RENOVATION Phase 1 artifact schemas.

status.description: Authoritative status vocabulary. UNKNOWN, NOT_RUN, BLOCKED, TIMEOUT, and PARTIAL are never equivalent to PASS.

isoDateTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when known; empty string is not allowed — use omission or explicit UNKNOWN status instead.

revision.description: Git commit SHA, release tag, or explicit UNKNOWN if not available.

commandOrObservation.description: Exact command, check id, or observation label that produced this evidence.

logRef.description: Path or URI of the primary log/artifact supporting this record.

redactionNotes.description: What was redacted and why, if anything.

completenessLimits.description: Explicit limits on what this evidence does and does not prove.

sourceLabel.description: Provenance of a claim inside an intent or plan artifact.
